what: Explain or avoid unexplained jargon and unfamiliar names. In the same Plan 1b discussion (2026-10-20) the user had to ask what "Batik" (Apache's Java SVG library) and "oracle" (the trusted source of expected answers, here real Taprats) meant. Introduce a term with a one-line gloss on first use, or use a plainer name such as "Taprats reference harness".
